verdict.rationale: The docs say buyers can search and list Bazaar resources "with a generated OpenAPI client", which implies an OpenAPI spec exists for the discovery API. However, a probe of the standard spec paths on the docs domain (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 for all, so no downloadable spec location is confirmed. The llms.txt and per-page markdown docs are machine-readable, but they are documentation, not an API spec. Missing for 10: a documented, downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec URL, spec coverage of the facilitator/payment endpoints, and hands-on confirmation of retrieving the spec.
